stories.title: Trinet Group officer sells $48,507 in company stock

whatToWatch: Future Form 4 filings from Trinet insiders

stories.title: Nvidia board's reversal on Huang conduct issue raises independence questions
stories.summary: Nvidia's board reversed an earlier decision tied to CEO Jensen Huang, after Huang reportedly said he had violated the company's code of conduct, a source says. Critics say the reversal raises doubts about the board's independence. Nvidia has not detailed the conduct issue in public.
stories.whyItMatters: Nvidia is one of the most closely watched stocks in the market, so governance questions about its CEO and board can move investor sentiment.
whatToWatch: Whether Nvidia's board makes a public statement on the matter
questions: What specific conduct did Huang violate?
Why did the board reverse its earlier decision?

stories.title: Nikkei seen rising next year but falling short of record, Reuters poll finds
stories.summary: A Reuters poll of investors expects Japan's Nikkei index to rise over the next year but stay below its record high. The poll points to a reassessment of the AI trade among investors. The source gives no specific index target.
stories.whyItMatters: Japan's stock market has been a major beneficiary of the AI rally, so a reassessment signals how global investors now view AI-linked stocks.
whatToWatch: Nikkei performance through the rest of the year
Further investor surveys on the AI trade
questions: Which sectors are driving the reassessment?
What would it take for the Nikkei to reach a new record?
